item.title: Bonefish 101
item.description: The bonefish, considered one of the most often sought after saltwater game fish, is elusive, spooky, and fast, a ghost like fish that poses a real challenge to fly fisherman. It makes its home in some of the most beautiful tropic locations worldwide. The post Bonefish 101 first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.
